The '''Lorta system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Gendius sector/Legends|Gendius sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lorta/Legends|Lorta]].
